---
title: "Write and export your report"
---

Turn your checked outputs into a short explanation someone else can follow. Use this page for any of the supplied datasets or your own study.

## Prepare the report

Copy `templates/learner-report.qmd` to the repository root as `my-study-report.qmd`. Keeping it at the root makes the image paths below work as written.

| Dataset | Image folder to use in the report |
|---|---|
| Synthetic practice | `results/example/figures/` |
| DietSwap | `results/dietswap/figures/` |
| Mouse59 | `results/mouse59/figures/` |
| Your own study | `results/my-study/figures/` |

Replace all three image paths in the template with the folder for your dataset. Update the title and replace each writing prompt with your own text.

## What to include

Describe the question, sample groups, input selection, and analysis choices. Under each figure, write one observation supported by a saved table value. Explain the main limitation and one next question.

The independent sample calculation is optional. If you performed it, report the sample ID and agreement; otherwise state which table values you checked.

::: {.callout-note}
### Use AI, then check the evidence

Give AI the actual figures, table values, and your question. Ask for a draft description, then check every number, group label, and claim. Record a suggestion you accepted or changed and why. Share only data you are permitted to share.
:::

## Render and review

Run this command from the repository root:

```bash
quarto render my-study-report.qmd --to html
```

Use the output location printed by Quarto to open the HTML report. Check all three images, captions, and numerical statements. Keep the dataset's `session-info.txt` with your report and retain the input files and analysis decisions needed to reproduce it.

::: {.callout-note}
Rendering creates the report from existing outputs. It does not rerun the analysis. If your inputs changed, rerun the appropriate command on [Run the workflow](01-run-the-workflow.qmd) first.
:::
